It does not establish individual receipt for every eligible consumer, remedy adequacy, correction of the underlying harm, continued work or service use, trust, switching, exit, or durable household recovery.

records.title: Digital rental listings are becoming a housing-access, identity-risk, and upfront-loss exposure
records.source_unit: FTC Consumer Data Spotlight: Rental scams hit home with $65 million in reported losses
records.geography: United States; Consumer Sentinel Network reports, January 2020 through June 2025, with age comparison July 2024 through June 2025
records.boundary: This record adds a housing-search platform and consumer-recourse route. It does not estimate the prevalence of rental fraud, prove platform liability, identify unique victims, measure completed identity theft, establish housing displacement, or show that reported losses were recovered.

records.title: Subscription design can convert inattention into billing and make exit costly
records.source_unit: Federal Trade Commission subscription-enforcement records concerning Shutterstock Inc. and Uber Technologies/Uber USA; institutional cases, not population samples
records.geography: United States federal consumer-protection enforcement; online content, transportation, delivery, and membership subscription flows
records.boundary: This record promotes one current digital-subscription enforcement case into the broader atlas. It observes an alleged attention-to-billing and exit-friction mechanism plus proposed institutional controls; it does not establish national subscription burden, causal household hardship, consumer dependence, or whether the remedy prevents recurrence. The next test is same-case implementation and account-level follow-up with notice, charge, cancellation effort, refund/relief receipt, continued use, switching, and trust kept separate.

records.title: Platform privacy controls can exist while practical data control remains uncertain
records.source_unit: FTC Section 6(b) staff report based on responses from nine large social-media and video-streaming companies
records.geography: United States platform market and companies reviewed by the FTC
records.boundary: This record measures reported platform practices and FTC staff assessment for nine companies. It does not establish a user-level deletion failure rate, individual harm, downstream data use, actual reappearance, safety, trust, or durable exit.

records.title: Social media is a growing route for reported consumer scam losses
records.source_unit: FTC Consumer Protection Data Spotlight using Consumer Sentinel Network reports that indicate social media as the scam contact method
records.geography: United States; public fraud reports to the FTC and its reporting partners
records.boundary: This record adds a reported material-loss and trust-risk route through social platforms. It does not estimate true fraud prevalence, platform causation, individual exposure, recoverability, household security, or the effect of reporting or enforcement. Reported losses and platform use are not the same denominator.

records.title: A price-discrimination order can define a small-business compensation trigger while local competition and retailer recovery remain open
records.source_unit: Federal Trade Commission Southern Glazer's Wine and Spirits settlement announcement, complaint, and proposed stipulated order
records.geography: Independent wine and spirits retailers and competing chain retailers in 26 U.S. states covered by the proposed order
records.boundary: This record advances a bounded supplier-price-discrimination-to-compensation-control route for small independent retailers. It does not establish final court approval, retailer eligibility, payment, price correction, business survival, consumer prices, local competition, household benefit, or durable trust.

records.title: A mandated platform-removal route creates digital recourse without proving restored safety or exit
records.source_unit: Federal Trade Commission enforcement guidance and complaint route for Section 3 of the TAKE IT DOWN Act; national platform-governance rule and escalation surface, not a sample of individual removal cases
records.geography: United States covered online platforms, victims and survivors, and FTC consumer-protection enforcement
records.boundary: This record adds a current digital-remedy architecture stage: a formal platform request, a 48-hour obligation, duplicate-copy scope, request traceability guidance, and federal escalation route. It does not establish an individual removal, complete deletion, recurrence prevention, survivor safety, wellbeing, trust, switching, or exit. The next test would require authorized request-level or platform case evidence preserving validity, response, removal, recurrence, and later outcome separately.

records.title: Platform safety is becoming a time-bounded removal and complaint-governance obligation
records.source_unit: FTC enforcement guidance and covered online platforms under Section 3 of the TAKE IT DOWN Act
records.geography: United States online platforms and people seeking removal of nonconsensual intimate images
records.boundary: This record adds a platform-governance and consumer-recourse mechanism: a harm previously handled through platform discretion is assigned a deadline, request protocol, and regulator complaint route. It does not show individual removal, safety, privacy, trust repair, or durable non-recurrence.

records.title: A platform-worker judgment can separate missing-pay correction from restored work control
records.source_unit: Federal Trade Commission and state enforcement case, court-entered order, and official Walmart Spark Driver payment FAQ; affected drivers are a remedy-program population, not a representative worker sample
records.geography: United States Walmart Spark Driver program; settlement relief is nationwide for eligible drivers
records.boundary: This record establishes a court-entered platform-worker remedy with explicit allocation, nationwide eligibility, pre-announcement payment timing, and a ten-year earnings-verification program. It does not establish the eligible-driver denominator, individual payment receipt, restored earnings opportunity, continued or alternative work, schedule control, trust, switching, or exit.

records.title: FTC-reported Walmart wire-transfer checks move a fraud remedy into dispatch while cashing remains unverified
records.source_unit: FTC Walmart wire-transfer fraud-remedy announcement, case page, and timeline record
records.geography: United States consumers affected by fraud-induced Walmart wire transfers
records.boundary: This record follows a named consumer-redress route from alleged wire-transfer control failures to reported check dispatch. It does not establish individual delivery, cashing, adequacy, original-loss recovery, fraud recurrence, trust, switching, or exit.

records.title: A repeat small-business refund can verify prior payment acceptance without proving the new payment or restored operating security
records.source_unit: FTC Yellowstone Capital merchant cash advance refund program and third-payment route
records.geography: United States small businesses affected by Yellowstone Capital merchant cash advances
records.boundary: This record establishes an official repeat-refund route with a prior-cashing condition for small businesses. It does not establish third-payment receipt, adequate recovery, account correction, business survival, trust, switching, or exit.

records.title: Collective memory of 9/11 remains broad while personal lifestyle change and terrorism worry are lower and confidence in government protection is partisan
records.source_unit: Gallup national poll conducted August 3-24, 2026, with anniversary trend comparisons from 2000-2021
records.geography: United States
records.boundary: This record adds a long-horizon cultural-memory, security-perception, and partisan legitimacy layer. It does not infer actual lifestyle behavior, terrorism incidence, government protection capability, causal effects of 9/11 memory, or respondent-level trajectories.

records.title: Frequent workplace AI use can raise displacement fear while supportive management changes the meaning of the same exposure
records.source_unit: Gallup Panel workforce studies of employed U.S. adults, four waves from 2023 through early 2026
records.geography: United States employed adults
records.boundary: This record establishes a same-worker longitudinal association between workplace AI exposure/use, displacement concern, perceived management support, and job-attitude measures. It does not establish actual job loss, wage or schedule change, worker bargaining power, organizing, household security, political action, or causal management effects.

records.title: AI exposure can intensify displacement fear unless management makes worker value and transition visible
records.source_unit: Gallup Workplace, Using AI More Does Not Reassure Workers, Managers Do, September 9, 2026
records.geography: United States; employed adults aged 18 and older in Gallup Panel workforce studies
records.boundary: This record adds a worker-level implementation mechanism to the AI transition theme: the same AI exposure can be interpreted as threat or manageable change depending partly on respect, wellbeing support, communication and perceived worker value. The source is observational panel analysis; it does not establish causal effects of AI use or management, actual job elimination, productivity, wages, retention or successful transition.

records.title: National anniversary participation is organized more through family, community, learning, and stories than official ceremony alone
records.source_unit: With Honor and Gallup survey of US adults about planned recognition of the nation's 250th anniversary
records.geography: United States
records.boundary: This record establishes planned national-anniversary participation, social and educational ritual routes, and sources of pride and optimism. It does not establish actual attendance, cross-party agreement, historical learning, civic capacity, policy support, institutional trust, or durable political action.

records.title: Local business retention depends more on relational ecosystem and usable support than on headline cost ratings alone
records.source_unit: Gallup Pathways to Wealth, Half of U.S. Business Owners See Local Area as Good for Business, September 8, 2026
records.geography: United States; business owners, primarily recruited from the probability-based Gallup Panel
records.boundary: This record adds a place-and-firm retention mechanism: local business ecosystems are judged through customer access, support networks, regulation and public services, while dissatisfaction is associated with owner relocation intention, especially among growth-expecting firms. It does not establish causal local-policy effects, actual moves, firm survival, employment, revenue, tax base or community welfare outcomes.

records.title: Community participation is constrained by information and invitation as well as time
records.source_unit: Gallup and Charles F. Kettering Foundation community-involvement study
records.geography: United States
records.boundary: This record supports an access-and-translation subtheme for community participation. It does not prove that free time is irrelevant, estimate the effect of invitations, measure objective opportunity, or establish a causal path from participation to democratic legitimacy.

records.title: Perceived decline in social courage can coexist with strong support for principled action and fear of its costs
records.source_unit: With Honor and Gallup 2026 national survey on courage and the costs of speaking up
records.geography: United States
records.boundary: This record establishes a current perception of declining courage and concern about the cost of principled action. It does not establish a decline in actual courage, retaliation, political participation, workplace voice, or public safety.

records.title: Crypto participation is retreating from its speculative peak while risk awareness remains high and unevenly distributed
records.source_unit: Gallup, U.S. Crypto Ownership Falls From 2025 High, September 21, 2026
records.geography: United States; adults and investors, with investors defined as those holding $10,000 or more in investable assets
records.boundary: This record adds a consumer-financial participation mechanism: crypto ownership has retreated from its 2025 peak while perceived risk remains high and participation stays concentrated among younger men and higher-income investors. It does not establish realized returns, losses, financial harm, suitability, debt, regulation, causal market behavior or durable cultural adoption.

records.title: Federal workforce reductions weaken local job confidence while housing costs remain the main exit pressure in the Washington region
records.source_unit: 2026 Greater Washington Community Foundation-Gallup Community Insights report and September 23, 2026 Gallup summary
records.geography: Greater Washington region: District of Columbia, Maryland, and Virginia
records.boundary: This record adds a place-specific public-sector shock, local labor-market confidence, housing-payment pressure, and prospective mobility layer. It does not infer verified layoffs, income changes, firm closures, regional migration, causal federal-workforce effects, household recovery, or local policy effectiveness.

records.title: Economic-system attitudes combine rising socialism appeal with durable support for small business and market choice
records.source_unit: Gallup Poll Social Series telephone survey of 1,200 U.S. adults interviewed August 3–24, 2026
records.geography: United States; adults ages 18 and older in all 50 states and the District of Columbia
records.boundary: This record identifies U.S. favorability patterns and repeated changes in views of socialism, capitalism, free enterprise, small business, and big business. It does not establish ideology, policy preference, economic behavior, firm performance, inequality, labor power, voting, or causal cohort conversion.

records.title: Election anxiety is broad, partisan in its targets, and connected to confidence in democratic administration
records.source_unit: Gallup and Charles F. Kettering Foundation, Election Concerns Run High Ahead of 2026 Midterms, July 29, 2026
records.geography: United States; adults surveyed ahead of the 2026 congressional and state elections
records.boundary: This record adds a U.S. election-legitimacy route connecting perceived election risks, partisan threat interpretation, social-media intensity, accountability, political finance, representation, and institutional confidence. It is a large cross-sectional survey, not an election-security audit, forecast, turnout estimate, causal media study, or evidence that concern translates into participation or rejection of outcomes.

records.title: Workplace monitoring becomes a trust and control boundary shaped by purpose, transparency, and employee voice
records.source_unit: Gallup Workplace, Employee Data Use: One in Five Trust Leaders a Great Deal, September 24, 2026
records.geography: United States; employees who regularly work on a computer or another device, with engagement, role, access, and communication comparisons
records.boundary: This record adds a workplace data-governance and control layer: employee monitoring is interpreted through purpose, transparency, engagement, role power, and perceived fairness. It does not establish actual surveillance practices, legal compliance, consent, productivity effects, turnover, causal engagement change, or worker bargaining outcomes.

records.title: Financially stressed adults seek guidance through closer networks and AI while trust in AI remains low
records.source_unit: Gallup and Edward Jones survey of US and Canadian adults seeking financial guidance in the prior year
records.geography: United States and Canada; US comparisons retained as the primary unit
records.boundary: This record establishes a financial-guidance source mix, financial-stress differences, and low AI confidence. It does not establish recommendation quality, financial decision influence, affordability improvement, harm, human substitution, or later trust, switching, or recovery.

records.title: AI is entering financial guidance as a low-cost research layer without becoming a trusted decision-maker
records.source_unit: Gallup and Edward Jones Financial Fulfillment study, public article on where Americans seek financial guidance
records.geography: United States; adults age 21 and older; survey fielded March 20-April 6, 2026
records.boundary: This record adds a financial-guidance trust-and-access route: AI and internet research are low-friction entry points, while professional and human-network sources retain greater confidence for consequential decisions. It does not establish advice quality, financial outcomes, fiduciary protection, or causal substitution between AI and human guidance.

records.title: Perceived government corruption reaches a record high and is broadly bipartisan, while the government-business gap widens
records.source_unit: Gallup World Poll U.S. country estimate and party-conditioned comparisons reported September 2, 2026
records.geography: United States; adults, with comparison to OECD countries
records.boundary: This record identifies a sharp rise and broad partisan convergence in perceived U.S. government corruption, a government-business perception gap, and a U.S.-OECD comparison. It does not establish actual corruption, individual exposure, specific offenders or offices, institutional use or exit, reform preference, collective action, or geopolitical consequences.

records.title: Public industry legitimacy is weakening most where firms are associated with household costs, technological disruption and visible risk
records.source_unit: Gallup, Computer Sector Leads Drops in Industry Ratings, September 17, 2026
records.geography: United States; adults in Gallup Poll Social Series telephone survey
records.boundary: This record adds a sector-legitimacy mechanism: public ratings weaken for industries linked to household costs, technology disruption and visible risk, while partisan context shapes overall industry judgment. It does not establish causal drivers, actual prices, service quality, consumer behavior, firm revenue, regulation or sector performance.

records.title: Political influencer audiences do not simply mirror their parties: they combine stronger protest support with sharper doubts about institutional accountability
records.source_unit: Gallup and Charles F. Kettering Foundation analysis, What Podcaster Audiences Want From U.S. Democracy, June 15, 2026
records.geography: United States; adults in the 2025 Democracy for All / Kettering-Gallup study
records.boundary: This record adds a U.S. media-to-politics route connecting influencer news use, democratic norms, protest and voting efficacy, accountability judgments, and institutional skepticism. It is a secondary analysis of a survey with small, selected influencer-audience subgroups; it does not establish creator causality, media exposure effects, actual political participation, persuasion, or institutional performance.

records.title: Institutional confidence remains near historic lows while technology and small-business legitimacy diverge
records.source_unit: Gallup annual Confidence in Institutions poll and long-running institution trend series
records.geography: United States
records.boundary: This record measures reported confidence in institutions, not institutional performance, legitimacy, usage, compliance, switching, political action, or causal polarization. The 14-institution average mixes public and private entities and must not replace institution-specific analysis.

records.title: Institutional confidence is low overall but highly conditional on political and social position
records.source_unit: Gallup Poll Social Series respondent; U.S. adults asked confidence in named institutions
records.geography: United States
records.boundary: This is a bounded reported Gallup confidence layer. It establishes institution-specific national, party, and racial-group confidence differences, not institutional performance, material causation, discrimination causation, political withdrawal, service use, legitimacy, or geopolitical/state capacity. The underlying respondent microdata are not locally archived in this pass.

records.title: Employer health insurance is constraining job mobility for a large minority of U.S. workers
records.source_unit: West Health-Gallup Center on Healthcare in America study of job lock
records.geography: United States; employed adults relying primarily on employer-sponsored health insurance; underlying study fielded October 27-December 22, 2025
records.boundary: This record adds an employment-linked healthcare route from coverage dependence through job lock, medical debt, chronic-condition exposure, gender differences and constrained mobility. It does not establish causal job lock, actual job transitions, wage effects, entrepreneurship, coverage alternatives, healthcare outcomes or the sole role of insurance in employment decisions.

records.title: Americans retain commitment to democracy while national performance and accountability decline, producing a local-national legitimacy split
records.source_unit: Gallup and Charles F. Kettering Foundation, Democracy for All Project: Frustration Rises, Commitment Endures
records.geography: United States adults, with national and local democratic assessments and subgroup analysis in a large 2026 survey
records.boundary: This record adds a local-national democratic-legitimacy route: commitment to democratic ideals can coexist with declining national performance judgments, weak accountability confidence, rule-of-law concern, and stronger local evaluations. It does not establish institutional failure, causal local buffering, actual participation, policy influence, or durable democratic recovery.

records.title: Democratic commitment persists while national performance judgments weaken and local legitimacy is stronger
records.source_unit: Gallup and Charles F. Kettering Foundation Democracy for All Project survey
records.geography: United States
records.boundary: This record supports a descriptive local-national legitimacy contrast. It does not measure democratic performance objectively, prove institutional failure, identify a causal source of frustration, or observe later voting, organizing, trust change, or exit.

records.title: Observed kindness is common but comfort initiating it is age- and exposure-structured
records.source_unit: Values in Action/Gallup web survey of more than 2,000 U.S. adults interviewed March 2–18, 2026 through the Gallup Panel
records.geography: United States; adults ages 18 and older
records.boundary: This record identifies a cross-sectional association between recent kindness exposure, perceived kindness, and comfort initiating kindness, with age gradients. It does not establish causal reciprocity, actual aid delivery, adequacy, institutional response, durable social trust, or later civic or political action.

records.title: Americans judge local democracy more positively than national democracy while democratic commitment persists
records.source_unit: 2026 Democracy for All Project survey by Gallup and the Charles F. Kettering Foundation, April 24-June 10, 2026
records.geography: United States
records.boundary: This record adds a local-versus-national legitimacy and democratic-meaning layer. It does not infer democratic performance, institutional causality, local government effectiveness, participation, electoral behavior, or durable democratic decline from the survey judgments.

records.title: Education is a widely valued American-Dream institution whose perceived school performance tracks opportunity hope
records.source_unit: Milken Center for Advancing the American Dream and Gallup American Dream Study, second wave
records.geography: United States; nationally representative survey of more than 6,300 adults, fielded January 7-March 4, 2026
records.boundary: This record adds an education-to-opportunity-legitimacy route from cultural valuation of quality education through perceived K-12 performance, intergenerational hope and institutional confidence. It does not establish school effectiveness, causal effects on optimism, student achievement, classroom conditions or policy impact.

records.title: A small rebound in media confidence does not undo historically weak and partisan trust
records.source_unit: Gallup Governance poll and long-run U.S. media-confidence trend
records.geography: United States; adults surveyed September 1-17, 2026
records.boundary: This record adds a media-legitimacy route from long-run confidence decline through partisan divergence, event-sensitive rebound and possible source-selection or civic consequences. It does not measure news accuracy, exposure, outlet-level trust, sharing, correction, misinformation, causal political behavior or the effect of post-fieldwork events.

records.title: Shared judgments of moral decline can coexist with disagreement over whether government should promote values
records.source_unit: Gallup May 2026 Values and Beliefs poll and moral-values survey
records.geography: United States; national adults, party groups, and religious-attendance groups
records.boundary: This record establishes national cultural judgments about perceived moral decline, government influence, and the legitimate public role of government. It does not establish objective moral change, causal policy effects, personal behavior change, political action, institutional legitimacy change, or exit.

records.title: Menopause is an information and care-navigation gap with consequences for work and community participation
records.source_unit: Gallup-Pivotal Women's Health Survey, menopause and perimenopause findings
records.geography: United States; women and men surveyed online July 14-22, 2026
records.boundary: This record adds a life-stage health-information and care-navigation route from distributed knowledge and provider access through recognition, treatment continuity, work, self-care and community participation. It does not measure objective knowledge, clinical severity, treatment effectiveness, employer response, causal career effects or universal menopause experience.

records.title: Women’s healthcare barriers spill into work, care, relationships, and civic participation
records.source_unit: Gallup-Pivotal Women's Health Survey, Women's Healthcare Barriers Extend Into Work and Family Life, September 18, 2026
records.geography: United States; adults surveyed nationally with women-specific, men-comparison, workforce, life-stage, and menopause/perimenopause measures
records.boundary: This record adds a gendered care-to-capacity route: dismissal, diagnostic delay, and treatment barriers can be read alongside work, caregiving, relationships, and civic participation. It does not establish clinical causality, provider discrimination as a sole mechanism, unmet-care prevalence for every condition, workplace accommodation, or durable participation and economic outcomes.

records.title: Classroom technology becomes more legitimate when teachers retain operational control over it
records.source_unit: Gallup, Screens Ubiquitous in Classrooms; Teachers Split on Efficacy, September 16, 2026
records.geography: United States; K-12 public school teachers
records.boundary: This record adds a classroom-technology governance mechanism: the legitimacy of ubiquitous learning devices appears to depend partly on teacher oversight, implementation control and bounded safeguards. The publication is cross-sectional and perception-based; it does not establish causal effects on learning, attention, behavior, teacher retention, equity or policy outcomes.

records.title: Global approval of the United Nations coexists with sharp country and role-specific doubts about performance
records.source_unit: Gallup World Poll 2025 surveys across 137 countries and Gallup U.S. probability-based panel survey, September 1-14, 2026
records.geography: Global; United States comparison
records.boundary: This record adds a global-institution support-versus-performance layer. It does not infer UN effectiveness, diplomatic behavior, public participation, membership preference, or causal effects from approval and role-specific performance evaluations.

records.title: Headline unemployment can coexist with a broader public experience of work slack and unmet job fit
records.source_unit: Gallup Chairman's Blog, Unemployment: A National Misunderstanding, September 21, 2026
records.geography: United States; national labor-market measurement and public interpretation
records.boundary: This record captures a measurement-and-legitimacy argument, not a new labor-market estimate. It preserves the distinction between official unemployment, U-6, nonparticipation, caregiving, disability, job fit and meaningful work. It does not establish a replacement unemployment rate, causal policy error, the number of people who want work, or a verified 12% real-unemployment prevalence.

records.title: Public demand for stronger collective worker voice is rising faster than confidence that unions can regain power
records.source_unit: Gallup, Record-High 47% Want Unions to Have More Influence, September 1, 2026
records.geography: United States; adults in Gallup's annual Work and Education poll
records.boundary: This record adds a collective-voice and institutional-capacity route: Americans increasingly want unions to have more influence and approve of them, but fewer expect unions to become stronger. It does not establish membership, organizing activity, bargaining coverage, strikes, wages, firm behavior, legislative change or causal effects of union influence.

records.title: Students’ future confidence is strongly associated with meaningful schoolwork, teacher recognition, belonging and individualized support
records.source_unit: Walton Family Foundation–Gallup Voices of Gen Z Study, Engaged Students More Confident in Their Post-High School Future
records.geography: United States; middle- and high-school students aged 14–19
records.boundary: This record adds a U.S. education-and-belonging layer: future confidence is patterned with meaningful schoolwork, teacher recognition, individualized support and belonging, with a notable gap for students not planning college. It is a sponsored cross-sectional web survey and association analysis, not respondent-level longitudinal data, a causal school evaluation, an achievement measure, a clinical assessment or proof that one intervention will close the gap.

records.title: Perceived business benefits of workforce diversity can rise across parties while DEI performance judgments remain divided
records.source_unit: Bentley University-Gallup Business in Society survey reporting
records.geography: United States
records.boundary: This record establishes a current survey pattern in how Americans judge workforce diversity and business performance. It does not establish actual firm outcomes, employee treatment, causal diversity effects, or durable political consensus.

records.title: Aggregate religious decline contains a young-men reversal in importance and attendance
records.source_unit: Gallup biennial religion aggregates by age and gender
records.geography: United States; adults ages 18 and older, with a focus on adults ages 18–29
records.boundary: This record identifies a young-men reversal in reported religious importance and attendance inside a broader low-religiosity U.S. context. It does not establish a durable revival, causal party or gender mechanism, congregation-level growth, political mobilization, public legitimacy, or later civic action.

records.title: Advanced-semiconductor export controls moved into multi-agency and private-sector compliance, while foreign response remained unmeasured
records.source_unit: GAO-25-107386 review of Commerce/BIS implementation of 2022-2023 advanced-semiconductor export-control rules
records.geography: United States, China-related semiconductor controls, foreign partners, and affected private-sector firms
records.boundary: This record adds the implementation and compliance stage between an export-control decision and any strategic result. It does not establish foreign-partner adoption, Chinese substitution, changed military capability, domestic incidence, deterrence, or durable U.S. geopolitical leverage.

records.title: Federal AI use is advancing faster than complete privacy guidance
records.source_unit: U.S. Government Accountability Office GAO-26-107681 review of expert-identified AI privacy risks and OMB government-wide AI guidance as of January 2026
records.geography: United States federal agencies and members of the public whose personal information is collected or used in government AI systems
records.boundary: This record identifies a federal AI privacy-governance gap between technology use, expert-identified risk, guidance, and public control. It does not establish a privacy breach, individual harm, agency noncompliance, causal trust change, political action, or successful deletion or remedy for any person.

records.title: Airport transit availability is not the same as practical mobility
records.source_unit: U.S. Government Accountability Office GAO-26-107817; airport public-transit availability, passenger and employee use, and transportation-demand management
records.geography: United States commercial airports; all 31 large-hub airports and selected medium/small airports, plus Census employee-commute estimates
records.boundary: This record establishes airport transit supply, use, and demand-management stages beneath practical mobility. It does not establish route-level accessibility, completed trips, missed work, household transport cost, airport labor supply, congestion, emissions, intervention effects, trust, or political response.

records.title: Assisted-living coverage and spending do not establish an affordable, available care setting
records.source_unit: U.S. Government Accountability Office GAO-26-107884; federal assisted-living spending, Medicaid coverage, and state waiver structure
records.geography: United States assisted-living facilities and state Medicaid programs for older adults and people with disabilities
records.boundary: This record establishes assisted-living financing, Medicaid policy coverage, waiver, and care-bundle stages. It does not establish total spending, resident affordability, unmet need, wait time, available slots, provider capacity, quality, safety, health, family work/time, displacement, setting choice, trust, or exit.

records.title: A safety system can identify communication threats before it can monitor them in real time
records.source_unit: U.S. Government Accountability Office GAO-26-108439 review of FAA spectrum-related threats, eight National Airspace System systems, collaboration practices, and aircraft communication applications
records.geography: United States National Airspace System and international flight routes using FAA-relevant aviation communications
records.boundary: This record establishes identified aviation communication and spectrum-security vulnerabilities plus incomplete monitoring and coordination controls. It does not establish a cyberattack, outage, accident, passenger harm, flight-level risk rate, or failure of a particular aircraft operation.

records.title: A formal reentry route can exist while timing and capacity delay usable return
records.source_unit: GAO audit of Federal Bureau of Prisons eligibility timing, residential reentry center and home-confinement capacity, and contractor payments
records.geography: United States federal prison and residential reentry system
records.boundary: This record adds a federal reentry timing, capacity, provider-payment, and data-legibility boundary. It does not follow the same person from eligibility through transfer, services, housing, work, health, community reconnection, later justice contact, trust, or durable inclusion.

records.title: Disaster-resilience funding becomes a lived public-system outcome only when grant review, policy continuity, and measurement work
records.source_unit: U.S. Government Accountability Office, FEMA: Billions in Building Resilient Infrastructure and Communities Subgrants Remain Unawarded (GAO-26-107774)
records.geography: United States; FEMA BRIC applicants and subapplicants across states, territories, Tribes, and local governments
records.boundary: This record captures a public-system conversion problem: resilience need and federal appropriations pass through review time, policy continuity, communication, local capacity, and outcome measurement before they become completed protective infrastructure. It is a GAO administrative and interview-based audit, not a national estimate of avoided disaster losses or a respondent-level household study.

records.title: Broadband funding can move before targeting and long-term service are verified
records.source_unit: U.S. Government Accountability Office review of nine federal broadband deployment programs
records.geography: United States; federal broadband programs, states, territories, Tribes, and underserved locations
records.boundary: This record measures federal broadband funding, targeting, completion-data availability, sustainability oversight, and one Tribal program's awards and intended locations. It does not establish completed connections, price, subscription, reliability, meaningful use, or financial failure.

records.title: A broadband shortcut can exist on paper while the coordination needed to use it remains uneven
records.source_unit: U.S. Government Accountability Office GAO-26-107734 review of the Federal Highway Administration's 2021 broadband infrastructure deployment rule
records.geography: United States; 50 states, Puerto Rico, and the District of Columbia, with selected state review
records.boundary: This record adds the institutional coordination layer behind broadband deployment along federal-aid highways. It does not establish that a highway right-of-way received fiber, that a project reduced cost or disruption, that a provider served a household, or that service was affordable, reliable, or durable.

records.title: Private port partnerships can expand border-processing capacity while changing who funds the route
records.source_unit: U.S. Government Accountability Office GAO-26-108751 review of CBP Reimbursable Services Program and Donations Acceptance Program
records.geography: United States; 328 land, sea, and air ports of entry and CBP public-private partnership agreements through fiscal year 2025
records.boundary: This record establishes a public-private capacity and funding route at U.S. ports of entry. It does not establish faster queues, better inspection quality, lower trade or travel costs, equal access, public control over decisions, local fiscal effects, or geopolitical border outcomes.

records.title: Central American police-training programs lacked consistent human-rights objectives and consolidated outcome data

records.boundary: This record advances a bounded paid-preparer anonymity-to-IRS detection and strategy route. records.title: Federal IT risk ratings can understate project exposure while oversight and delivery outcomes remain open
records.source_unit: U.S. Government Accountability Office GAO-27-108416 review of Federal IT Dashboard investment risk ratings

records.boundary: This record advances a bounded federal IT investment rating-to-oversight route. records.title: Vertically integrated Part D sponsors can steer prescriptions toward owned pharmacies while beneficiary and community-pharmacy effects remain mixed

records.title: Military modernization and operational demand can coexist with readiness and sustainment gaps
records.source_unit: GAO-26-108888, Military Readiness: DOD Should Take Further Actions to Address Challenges Across the Air, Sea, Ground, and Space Domains

records.boundary: This record shows a readiness-conversion problem: military activity, modernization, and strategic demand can coexist with maintenance, personnel, quality-of-life, data, and availability gaps. records.title: Mortgage trigger-lead restrictions formalize a privacy-to-comparison tradeoff while realized housing effects remain open

records.boundary: This record advances a housing-and-platform conversion route from credit-data dissemination to attention, privacy, comparison, and statutory control. records.title: Federal housing support can exist while Native housing insecurity remains hard to count and underfunded

records.boundary: This record captures a preliminary federal-program landscape, reported funding inadequacy, and a possible mismatch between federal homelessness definitions and doubled-up housing insecurity in Native communities. records.title: A military can recognize an urgent technology shift while its organization still slows delivery
records.source_unit: GAO-26-109014, Robotic Autonomous Systems: Navy Needs to Address Leadership and Organizational Challenges to Meet Urgent Needs

records.title: NIH research-security controls can act on disclosed allegations while undisclosed affiliations and residual risk remain open

records.boundary: This record advances a bounded NIH research-security disclosure-to-risk-management route. records.title: NNSA modernization can carry a large contract base without clear criteria for separable deliverables and lessons

records.title: Shared federal facilities can convert specialized infrastructure into mission work and cost recovery while creating capacity dependence

records.title: National-lab partnership work can support mission capacity while competing for scarce specialized facilities and staff

records.boundary: This record measures reimbursed Strategic Partnership Project activity, site distribution, and reported capacity/mission connections in the NNSA enterprise. records.title: A billing protection can change provider participation without proving lower patient costs

records.title: Tax incentives can attract investment without proving community improvement

records.title: A broad early-childhood support system can coordinate programs while leaving outcome management incomplete

records.boundary: This record advances a bounded private-health-insurance enrollment-concentration route. It does not establish issuer choice loss for individual consumers, premium effects, plan quality, provider access, claims, medical care, employer wages, household burden, or health outcomes.

records.title: Libraries are expanding their civic role while aging facilities constrain access and resilience

records.title: Quantum-risk exposure can precede cryptography inventories, funding, and testing while federal systems remain dependent on vulnerable controls
